hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.rs) cd /d/Development/Claude/yapper/backend && cargo fmt -- "$f" 2>&1 | head -5 ;; *.svelte|*.ts) cd /d/Development/Claude/yapper/frontend && npx prettier --write "$f" --log-level warn 2>&1 | head -5 ;; esac'

bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.rs) echo "[cargo check]"; cd /d/Development/Claude/yapper/backend && cargo check --message-format short 2>&1 | grep -E "^error" | head -10 ;; *.svelte|*.ts) echo "[svelte-check]"; cd /d/Development/Claude/yapper/frontend && npx svelte-check --threshold error 2>&1 | grep -E "Error" | head -10 ;; migrations/*.sql) echo "[reminder] Run: cargo sqlx prepare in backend/" ;; esac'

bash -c 'cmd="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git push.*--force|git push.*-f"; then echo "BLOCKED: force push detected. Use --force-with-lease or confirm with user first."; exit 1; fi'
